dataset: TX94 2026-11-25 Final Unseen LinkedIn Case Study
created_for: Frozen prospective head-to-head between original main and citation-only PR11; answer key excluded from both agents

questions.question: Which signed variation approved new construction work, what exactly was added and at what cost, and did it authorize optional AI video analytics?
questions.expected_answer: Signed V-17 authorized fourteen stainless mounting brackets for signal cabinets on the East Viaduct access corridor for EUR 180,000; it did NOT approve optional AI video analytics.

questions.question: What is the full revised authorized contract value after the signed variation? Exclude the unsigned proposal.
questions.expected_answer: EUR 6,660,000 is the revised authorized contract value. The EUR 240,000 unsigned CR-23 was not included.

questions.question: Do the passing quality checks establish final contractual acceptance? Identify the outstanding certificate and who must sign it.
questions.expected_answer: No. Passing checks are not final acceptance. The Chief Systems Assurance Officer of Asterline Transit Authority must sign a System Acceptance Certificate; none has been issued.

questions.question: Which individual line items in the Selected Signed BOQ exceed EUR 1.2 million, strictly greater than, and what are their amounts?
questions.expected_answer: RS-102 EUR 1,290,000 and RS-104 EUR 1,790,000. RS-103 at exactly EUR 1,200,000 does not exceed the threshold.

questions.question: Contrast the internal readiness forecast, the binding signed contractual handover, and the unapproved requested new handover date.
questions.expected_answer: 18 November 2029 is internal planning; 28 November 2029 is binding signed handover; 12 December 2029 is only an unsigned proposed change in CR-23.

questions.question: How many platform-safety interlock checks passed out of the inspected total, and which sensor IDs still need recalibration?
questions.expected_answer: 15 of 18 passed; PS-04, PS-09, and PS-12 failed and require recalibration.

questions.question: Give the quantity and voltage of the platform-safety sensors, plus the number of remote signal cabinets.
questions.expected_answer: Twelve platform-safety sensors PS-01 through PS-12 operating at 24 VDC and six remote signal cabinets.

questions.question: Assuming the signed V-17 revised authorized total is used for retention, compute the five-percent holdback in EUR and show the inputs.
questions.expected_answer: Five percent of EUR 6,660,000 equals EUR 333,000; 5% retention on the revised signed authorized total, not on unsigned CR-23.
